title: Simple Layout
body:
I downloaded a whole bunch of habit tracking apps but decided on this one. I like the simple layout which shows you your current streaks for each habit. I also really like the visual representation of how many days out of the past 365 you did a habit. This especially helps if you break a streak, because you can still look back and see how many times you achieved your daily goal.

If you're looking for a habit app with lots of features and cool graphics this one probably isn't for you. But if you just want to keep track of what you did each day/week this one is great! I also appreciate that there is a buy outright option for the premium features, instead of locking you in to a subscription.

title: Expensive / Дорого
body:
Minuses:
- You can only create 2 habits in the free version.
- The lifetime version costs $40, which for a mobile app with such functionality, is VERY expensive.
- Annual subscription is 20 dollars, which is also expensive.
- Support doesn't respond to emails.

Pluses:
- Beautiful design.
- Convenient statistics.

1 star only for the beautiful design and handy stats, but the free version is impossible to use because of the 2 habits limit. Other apps usually have 5 free habits. Annual subscription costs $20, which is more expensive than most other similar apps with lifetime subscription.

————-

Минусы:
- В бесплатной версии можно создать только 2 привычки.
- Пожизненная версия стоит 40 долларов, что для мобильного приложения с таким функционалом, ОЧЕНЬ дорого.
- Годовая подписка 20 долларов, что также дорого.
- Поддержка не отвечает по имейлу.

Плюсы:
- Красивый дизайн.
- Удобная статистика.

1 звезда только за красивый дизайн и удобную статистику, однако бесплатной версией пользоваться невозможно из-за ограничения в 2 привычки. У других приложений обычно 5 бесплатных привычек. title: Super Habit = Atomic Habits!
body:
I love Super Habit, it is the perfect digital companion to the book Atomic Habits. After reading the book I struggled to find the perfect app to track my newly forming habits. Using a paper tracker was a PITA for my digital nomad life. Which brings me Super Habit. 

What a game changer! One of the biggest challenges of maintaining habits for me, was living on the road. Every new destination was new chaos for my life and trying to get into my daily routine usually failed. 

But with Super Habit I start my day, no matter my location, with my “list” of habits and voilà — much less chaos. Seeing my past success helps keep me motivated. 

There's only one tiny, insignificant detail I wish it had, which is why I rated it 4 ⭐️ instead of 5. 

If you could mark the habit done from the notifications screen, instead of taking you INTO the app, it would be perfect! I have other tracking apps that let you do that, but they lack all the great features of Super Habit. 

Also, the customer service and support are awesome 👏🏻 

Thanks!

title: My preferred habit tracker!
body:
The UI is so simple, clean, and easy to understand! It is not time consuming to use. After setting up the desired habits and finish them with a tap. I love how I can input my old data into the app. 

The free trial version only allows two habits to be tracked. The one time fee for unlimited trackable habits is so worth it because of the other useful features (dark mode, importing data, reminders, even changing the app color!)   

I love that there are no subscription fees and my data isn’t stored on a server! I don’t rate and buy  apps usually. Buying this app definitely was worth helping out a solo developer!
author: uyui03

title: Love Habit Tracking!
body:
I love the idea of habit tracking — from exercising (and having separate habits for each excerise I want to do) to eating healthy or going without spending. I’ve tried bullet journaling but it was hard to stay accountable for that, as I much prefer this digital means. On the free version, you can track two habits. I upgraded for $9 so I could get unlimited habits and dark mode (love that feature as well!) The upgrade to premium mode helps support an independent developer as well, so if you really like the app and can spend the money, I would recommend updating to get the unlimited habits and to help support the developer. 

The app interface is clean and easy to navigate. You can make this app work for whatever your needs are! Plus, the reminders are fantastic, as you can set up a certain amount of them per week (3 per week, every day, etc.) I find that extremely helpful to keep track of remembering to log your habits. A+!
author: nicomulder

title: Very good set of features, no subscription
body:
I’ve downloaded like, 20 different ‘habit’ apps and this one has many of the features and design I look for: 
- easy to tally habit as done, and they’re all on one page
- shows week,month, and year overview progress
- no subscription model for premium
- can tally previous days if you forget
- individual reminders and can have multiple of them
- shows streaks 

I’d like some badges/achievements, the ability to track negative habits (eg smoking), and also the ability to track multiple reps per day (eg if you want to keep track of glasses of water you’re drinking or pull-ups etc).
author: logmasterd

title: Love this app
body: This is the best App I’ve been able to find to keep me on track. It helps me keep focused on my daily exercise, my eating habits, like NOT eating things that I love that are bad for me and how many days I can go without eating CANDY. I’m a diabetic and it’s real challenge for me. There are so many things in my life that I  do that I want to stop doing and things that I don’t do that I want to start doing and I keep track of with this app. Needless to say I really like the app and I use it every single day to log my results with just a tap. I’ve been trying for 20 years to lose weight and this app has given me the extra help that I have needed to accomplish my weight loss goal. I finally got under 200 pounds by setting a goal not to eat after 6 PM, not to eat candy and things like that. The simple process of setting a goal and checking off every day showing that you’ve done what you planned really helps. I know that there are other good apps out there to accomplish the same thing but this one really works for me. I like simple, straightforward, uncomplicated easy to use apps that accomplishes my desired results. Oh, I don’t usually do reviews but I like this app so much that I went on and on and on. Sorry! Give it a try, I think you’ll like it!

title: Thoughtfully designed, useful app
body:
I have been using this app daily since 9/27 to track both good and bad habits. It's well designed, useful, and my favorite app in the quantified self category. I would only ask for two changes. 

1. The app is designed around positive habits that you want to sustain (e.g. exercise). It does not cater to habits you want to quit. It's subtle, but things like "TO DO," streaks, and minimum goal of 1/wk instead of 0. It's not hard to work around that, but for example I'd rather not see "TO DO" next to bad habits. Just an empty state check box is enough for both good and bad habits. 

2. It would be cool to stack different habits on one graph for comparison. But again, it's not hard to work around by just exporting the data.

title: Wonderful app and responsive creator
body:
I love this app for tracking daily habits. I haven’t tried weekly or x-times per week habits yet, but I expect to try that soon.
Pros- 
-Really easy to check off the box for previous days (useful for when I complete tasks after midnight but before bed, or when I work night shift so my days are not 12am-12am)
-great improvement to show the calendar week instead of the last 7 days! I track things by calendar week
-intuitive and satisfying to use
-the “zoomed out” view of 2019 of the past year is super motivating as the months go by
-nice to have % success rate because that’s how I evaluate myself
Cons-
-it would be nice to have a chance to look at a month zoomed out, and see % success rate for each month. I’m hopeful that the creator will continue to add features though, he has done so since I found the app from a reddit thread 6 months ago or so.
I’m a happy premium member!
